description: A forwarded message: the header block under the 'Forwarded message' marker introduces forwarded content, not reply history. The forwarded body MUST survive.

input.text:
FYI, see the pricing change below.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Vendor <billing@vendor.example>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 at 10:00
Subject: Price update
To: Bob <bob@example.com>

From 1 November the Pro plan costs $12 per month.

mustContain: FYI, see the pricing change below.
From 1 November the Pro plan costs $12 per month.
